revised_claim_text: Global cargo security market — physical screening + cargo tracking/telematics + logistics security services — estimated at ~$2.5–3.0B (2024) per independent commercial research frameworks: MarketsandMarkets supply chain security $2.52B (2024, 12.6% CAGR), Mordor cargo & vehicle screening $2.76B (2024, 6.5% CAGR). Growth band 7–13% CAGR depending on scope; APAC consistently flagged high-growth sub-region. The specific $3.1B (2024) / $7.8B (2033) / 10.7% CAGR / 13.2% APAC CAGR figures derive solely from marketintelo.com (commercial aggregator, auto-Low) — no independent corroboration. [ASSUMED-N]: precision implied by these figures unsupported.
